title.zh: 卷317 列傳一百四 王无党 吴进义 谭行义 李勋 樊廷 武进升 马负书 范毓皛
title.en: Volume 317 Biographies 104: Wang Wudang, Wu Jinyi, Tan Xingyi, Li Xun, Fan Ting, Wu Jinsheng, Ma Fushu, Fan Yuxiao
title.raw: 卷317 列傳一百四 王无党 吴进义 谭行义 李勋 樊廷 武进升 马负书 范毓皛

sentences.zh: 范毓皛}}

translations.literal: Fan Yuxiao; closing Wikisource template markup (}}).
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yuxiao.

sentences.zh: =王無黨=王無黨，直隸萬全人。

translations.literal: =Wang Wudang= Wang Wudang was a native of Wanquan in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wudang was a native of Wanquan in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 康熙五十一年武進士，授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year of Kangxi he passed the military examinations and was appointed a Blue Breechclout Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year of the Kangxi reign he passed the military examinations and was appointed a Blue Breechclout Guard.

sentences.zh: 累遷廣西梧州協副將。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to associate deputy commander of the Wuzhou Garrison in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to become associate deputy commander of the Wuzhou Garrison in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 貴州台拱九股苗為亂，無黨率師討定之，擢左江鎮總兵。

translations.literal: When the Jiugu Miao of Taigong in Guizhou rebelled, Wudang led troops to subdue them and was promoted to regional commander of Zuojiang.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jiugu Miao of Taigong in Guizhou rose in revolt, Wudang led his forces to pacify them and was promoted to regional commander of Zuojiang.

sentences.zh: 九股苗復為亂，無黨馳抵古州，分兵赴八寨督剿。

translations.literal: The Jiugu Miao rebelled again; Wudang hurried to Guzhou and divided his forces to supervise the campaign at Bazhai.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiugu Miao rebelled again; Wudang rushed to Guzhou, divided his troops, and personally directed the suppression at Bazhai.

sentences.zh: 經略張廣泗檄無黨分攻台拱大台雄，克之。

translations.literal: Commissioner-General Zhang Guangsi ordered Wudang to attack separately at Taigong, Daitai, and Xiong, and they were taken.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner-General Zhang Guangsi ordered Wudang to attack Taigong, Daitai, and Xiong in separate columns, and all were captured.

sentences.zh: 平交上等三十餘寨，擒其渠巴利，會收牛皮大箐。

translations.literal: He pacified more than thirty stockades including Jiaoshang, captured their leader Bali, and joined in securing the Great Cowhide Ravine.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified more than thirty stockades including Jiaoshang, captured the rebel leader Bali, and took part in securing the Great Cowhide Ravine.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，署貴州提督。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he served as acting provincial military governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qianlong reign he served as acting provincial military governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 從廣泗撫定上下九股諸苗從為亂者。

translations.literal: He followed Guangsi in pacifying the upper and lower Jiugu Miao who had joined the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Zhang Guangsi in pacifying the upper and lower Jiugu Miao who had joined the revolt.

sentences.zh: 二年，真除。

translations.literal: In the second year he received regular appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he received a regular appointment.

sentences.zh: 疏陳黔省急務，請籌積貯，築城垣，整墩台塘房，禁掠賣人口，下部議行。

translations.literal: He memorialized on urgent tasks in Guizhou, requesting grain reserves, city walls, beacon towers, watchhouses, and a ban on the abduction and sale of people; the ministries deliberated and implemented it.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial on urgent affairs in Guizhou, asking for grain reserves, city walls, beacon towers, watchhouses, and a prohibition on kidnapping and selling people; the ministries deliberated and carried it out.

sentences.zh: 定番州屬姑盧寨苗視險強肆，廣泗與無黨遣漢、土官兵三千餘，分道毀寨搜箐，擒其渠老排，十餘日而定，上褒其妥協。

translations.literal: Miao of Gulu Stockade in Dingfan Prefecture relied on difficult terrain and acted insolently; Guangsi and Wudang sent more than three thousand Han and native troops by separate routes to destroy stockades and search ravines, captured the leader Laopai, and within ten-odd days it was settled; the emperor praised their measured handling.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao of Gulu Stockade in Dingfan Prefecture, trusting in rugged terrain, acted insolently; Zhang Guangsi and Wudang sent more than three thousand Han and native troops along separate routes to destroy stockades and search ravines, captured the chieftain Laopai, and within a little more than ten days the matter was settled; the emperor praised their measured handling.

sentences.zh: 四年，陛見，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he had an audience at court and was granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he had an audience at court and was granted a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 六年，移湖廣提督。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to provincial military governor of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was transferred to provincial military governor of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 黑峒苗為亂，大學士鄂爾泰以無黨在貴州久，熟苗事，留使戡定乃上官。

translations.literal: When the Heidong Miao rebelled, Grand Secretary Ortai, because Wudang had long been in Guizhou and knew Miao affairs well, kept him to suppress the disturbance before he took up his new post.
translations.idiomatic: When the Heidong Miao rebelled, Grand Secretary Ortai, knowing that Wudang had long served in Guizhou and understood Miao affairs, kept him to put down the disturbance before he assumed his new post.

sentences.zh: 八年，上以湖廣軍政廢弛，無黨至官未有所整理，下詔詰責。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because military administration in Huguang was lax and Wudang had done nothing to set it in order since taking office, the emperor issued an edict of reprimand.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, because military administration in Huguang had grown lax and Wudang had done nothing to reform it since taking office, the emperor issued an edict reprimanding him.

sentences.zh: 十三年，坐提標兵救火攘衣物，兵部論無黨徇庇，當奪官，命詣京師引見，左授湖南沅州協副將。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, because troops of his command had snatched clothing while fighting a fire, the Board of War ruled that Wudang had shown favoritism and should be stripped of office; he was ordered to come to the capital for an audience and was demoted to associate deputy commander of the Yuanzhou Garrison in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, because troops under his command had snatched clothing while fighting a fire, the Board of War ruled that Wudang had shown favoritism and should be stripped of office; he was ordered to the capital for an audience and was demoted to associate deputy commander of the Yuanzhou Garrison in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 遷雲南楚姚鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was transferred to regional commander of Chuyao in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to regional commander of Chuyao in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 內擢鑾儀使。

translations.literal: He was promoted within the capital to Commissioner of the Imperial Procession.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted within the capital to Commissioner of the Imperial Procession.

sentences.zh: 复外授福建漳州鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was again sent out as regional commander of Zhangzhou in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: He was again sent out as regional commander of Zhangzhou in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 遷浙江提督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to provincial military governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to provincial military governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 以目疾乞罷。

translations.literal: He requested retirement on account of eye disease.
translations.idiomatic: He requested retirement on account of eye disease.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡壯愨。

translations.literal: He died and was given the posthumous name Zhuangmin.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was given the posthumous name Zhuangmin.

sentences.zh: =吳進義=吳進義，字子恆，陝西寧朔人。

translations.literal: =Wu Jinyi= Wu Jinyi, style name Ziheng, was a native of Ningshuo in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jinyi, style name Ziheng, was a native of Ningshuo in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 父開圻，康熙二十七年一甲三名武進士，官至雲南元江副將。

translations.literal: His father Kaichi, in the twenty-seventh year of Kangxi took third place among the top three military graduates and rose to deputy commander of Yuanjiang in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: His father Kaichi, in the twenty-seventh year of the Kangxi reign took third place among the top three military graduates and rose to deputy commander of Yuanjiang in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 進義入伍，從振武將軍孫思克徵噶爾丹，劄署守備，發江南借補千總。

translations.literal: Jinyi entered military service, followed General Sun Sike in campaigning against Galdan, was provisionally appointed defender, and was sent to Jiangnan to fill a vacancy as company commander.
translations.idiomatic: Jinyi entered military service, followed General Sun Sike in the campaign against Galdan, was provisionally appointed defender, and was sent to Jiangnan to fill a vacancy as company commander.

sentences.zh: 累遷江南壽春鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to regional commander of Shouchun in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to regional commander of Shouchun in Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 擢江南提督，疏言：「太湖界江、浙，漁船姦良難辨。

translations.literal: He was promoted to provincial military governor of Jiangnan and memorialized: "Lake Tai lies on the border of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, and it is hard to distinguish good from bad among fishing boats.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to provincial military governor of Jiangnan and memorialized: "Lake Tai lies on the border of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, and it is hard to distinguish honest from dishonest among the fishing boats.

sentences.zh: 請照海洋例巡哨，支河小汛，飭兩省陸路兵巡查，則聲勢聯絡，姦宄斂跡。

translations.literal: Please patrol according to the precedent for the open sea; for lesser river posts, order land troops of both provinces to inspect, so that forces are linked and evildoers will shrink away.
translations.idiomatic: Please patrol according to the precedent used on the open sea; for lesser river posts, order land troops of both provinces to inspect, so that our forces are linked and wrongdoers will shrink away.

sentences.zh: 」有旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: " There was an imperial decree of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued a decree of commendation.

sentences.zh: 久之，移浙江，再移福建，復還浙江。

translations.literal: After a long time he was transferred to Zhejiang, then again to Fujian, and then returned to Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: After a long interval he was transferred to Zhejiang, then again to Fujian, and then returned to Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 時有偽為孫嘉淦疏稿語訐上，進義與浙閩總督喀爾吉善以聞。

translations.literal: At the time someone forged a memorial draft in Sun Jiagan’s name slandering the emperor; Jinyi and Zhejiang-Fujian Governor-General Kaerjishan reported it.
translations.idiomatic: At the time someone forged a memorial draft in Sun Jiagan’s name slandering the emperor; Jinyi and Zhejiang-Fujian Governor-General Kaerjishan reported it.

sentences.zh: 上令究所從來，語連提督廨胥吏，喀爾吉善劾進義隱諱，命解官聽讞。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered an investigation of its origin; the case implicated clerks in the provincial military governor’s office, and Kaerjishan impeached Jinyi for concealment and ordered him dismissed pending trial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered an investigation of its origin; the case implicated clerks in the provincial military governor’s office, and Kaerjishan impeached Jinyi for concealment and ordered him dismissed pending trial.

sentences.zh: 進義力辨未嘗隱諱，其幕客證進義已見稿。

translations.literal: Jinyi vigorously argued that he had never concealed anything; his staff testified that Jinyi had already seen the draft.
translations.idiomatic: Jinyi vigorously argued that he had never concealed anything; his staff testified that he had already seen the draft.

sentences.zh: 浙江巡撫雅爾哈善論進義當重闢，上愍其老，命貰罪。

translations.literal: Zhejiang Governor Yaharhashan ruled that Jinyi should receive heavy punishment; the emperor, pitying his age, ordered his crime pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang Governor Yaharhashan ruled that Jinyi should receive heavy punishment; the emperor, pitying his age, ordered his crime pardoned.

sentences.zh: 復以疏稿未得作偽主名，令江蘇巡撫莊有恭會鞫。

translations.literal: Because the forger of the draft had not been identified, he ordered Jiangsu Governor Zhuang Yougong to join in the inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Because the forger of the draft had not been identified, he ordered Jiangsu Governor Zhuang Yougong to join in the inquiry.

sentences.zh: 有恭疏陳進義實未見稿，浙江承審諸吏牽合附會。

translations.literal: Yougong memorialized that Jinyi had in fact never seen the draft and that the Zhejiang officials who tried the case had forced a connection.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuang Yougong memorialized that Jinyi had in fact never seen the draft and that the Zhejiang officials who tried the case had forced a connection.

sentences.zh: 事下軍機大臣覆訊，得實。

translations.literal: The matter was sent to the Grand Council for re-examination, and the truth was established.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was sent to the Grand Council for re-examination, and the truth was established.

sentences.zh: 上以進義無辜廢斥，召來京，命以提督銜署直隸宣化鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Because Jinyi had been dismissed without cause, he was summoned to the capital and appointed acting regional commander of Xuanhua in Zhili with the rank of provincial military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Because Jinyi had been dismissed without cause, he was summoned to the capital and appointed acting regional commander of Xuanhua in Zhili with the rank of provincial military governor.

sentences.zh: 未幾，授古北口提督。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed provincial military governor of Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed provincial military governor of Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 進義請限操演火藥，增設河屯協弓兵，皆允行。

translations.literal: Jinyi requested limits on drill powder and the addition of river-garrison bow troops; all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Jinyi requested limits on drill powder and the addition of river-garrison bow troops; all were approved.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was given the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was given the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，卒，年八十四，加太子太保，諡壯愨。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he died at eighty-four; he was given the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and the posthumous name Zhuangmin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he died at the age of eighty-four; he was given the title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and the posthumous name Zhuangmin.

sentences.zh: 進義家世多武功，從祖坤，貴州永北總兵，嘗徵四川苗及金川有功。

translations.literal: Jinyi’s family for generations had many military achievements; his collateral ancestor Kun, regional commander of Yongbei in Guizhou, had merit in campaigns against Sichuan Miao and the Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Jinyi’s family for generations had many military achievements; his collateral ancestor Kun, regional commander of Yongbei in Guizhou, had merit in campaigns against the Sichuan Miao and the Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 坤子開增，自武舉官至浙江溫州總兵。

translations.literal: Kun’s son Kaizeng rose from military licentiate to regional commander of Wenzhou in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Kun’s son Kaizeng rose from military licentiate to regional commander of Wenzhou in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: =譚行義=譚行義，四川三台人。

translations.literal: =Tan Xingyi= Tan Xingyi was a native of Santai in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Xingyi was a native of Santai in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 康熙時，以武舉授陝西西寧衛千總。

translations.literal: In the Kangxi period, as a military licentiate he was appointed company commander of Xining Garrison in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kangxi period, as a military licentiate he was appointed company commander of Xining Garrison in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 雍正初，從軍平青海，再遷河南城守營參將。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongzheng he followed the army in pacifying Qinghai and was twice promoted to colonel of the Chengguard Battalion in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yongzheng reign he followed the army in pacifying Qinghai and was twice promoted to colonel of the Chengguard Battalion in Henan.

sentences.zh: 河東總督田文鏡劾行義送陝西軍馬疲瘦，奪官，上令來京引見，召對稱旨，賜編刻上諭、貂皮、香珠，復原官。

translations.literal: Hedong Governor-General Tian Wenjing impeached Xingyi for delivering exhausted Shaanxi army horses; his office was taken away, but the emperor ordered him to the capital for an audience; his responses pleased the throne, and he was given an engraved copy of imperial edicts, sable fur, and fragrant pearls, and his former office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong Governor-General Tian Wenjing impeached Xingyi for delivering exhausted Shaanxi army horses; his office was taken away, but the emperor ordered him to the capital for an audience; his responses pleased the throne, and he was given an engraved copy of imperial edicts, sable fur, and fragrant pearls, and his former office was restored.

sentences.zh: 再遷廣東高雷廉總兵。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to regional commander of Gaolei and Lian in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to regional commander of Gaolei and Lian in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 總督鄂彌達檄行義將五千人協剿貴州亂苗，進擊滾縱、高表諸寨。

translations.literal: Governor-General Emida ordered Xingyi to lead five thousand men in concert to suppress rebellious Miao in Guizhou and advance against the stockades of Gunzong, Gaobiao, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Emida ordered Xingyi to lead five thousand men in concert to suppress rebellious Miao in Guizhou and advance against the stockades of Gunzong, Gaobiao, and others.

sentences.zh: 經略張廣泗令赴援上江，攻烏婆、擺吊諸險要地，搜牛皮大箐，獲其魁。

translations.literal: Commissioner-General Zhang Guangsi ordered him to reinforce the upper river, attack the strategic places of Wupo and Baidiao, search the Great Cowhide Ravine, and capture the chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner-General Zhang Guangsi ordered him to reinforce the upper river, attack the strategic places of Wupo and Baidiao, search the Great Cowhide Ravine, and capture the chieftains.

sentences.zh: 歷福建漳州、湖南鎮筸諸鎮。

translations.literal: He served in succession as regional commander of Zhangzhou in Fujian and Zhenjiang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He served in succession as regional commander of Zhangzhou in Fujian and Zhenjiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年，授廣西提督，帥師會討楚、粵亂苗。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianlong he was appointed provincial military governor of Guangxi and led troops in concert to suppress rebellious Miao in Chu and Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Qianlong reign he was appointed provincial military governor of Guangxi and led troops in concert to suppress rebellious Miao in Hunan and Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 宜山縣土蠻恃險劫掠，行義與總督馬爾泰、署巡撫安圖令游擊楊剛討之。

translations.literal: Native braves of Yishan County relied on difficult terrain to plunder; Xingyi, with Governor-General Maertai and acting Governor Antu, ordered Colonel Yang Gang to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Native braves of Yishan County relied on difficult terrain to plunder; Xingyi, with Governor-General Maertai and acting Governor Antu, ordered Colonel Yang Gang to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 破白土、丘索二村，執其渠，斬以徇。

translations.literal: They broke the villages of Baitu and Qiusuo, seized the ringleaders, and executed them as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: They broke the villages of Baitu and Qiusuo, seized the ringleaders, and executed them as a warning.

sentences.zh: 忻城土縣外八堡有劇盜曰藍明星，恃險焚劫。

translations.literal: Outside the eight forts of Xincheng Native District there was a notorious bandit named Lan Mingxing who relied on rugged terrain to burn and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the eight forts of Xincheng Native District there was a notorious bandit named Lan Mingxing who relied on rugged terrain to burn and plunder.

sentences.zh: 行義檄副將畢映捕治，明星遁入山，搜捕得之。

translations.literal: Xingyi ordered Deputy Commander Bi Ying to capture him; Mingxing fled into the mountains and was seized in the search.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyi ordered Deputy Commander Bi Ying to capture him; Mingxing fled into the mountains and was seized in the search.

sentences.zh: 有黃順者，匿湖北、廣東錯壤處，謀為亂。

translations.literal: There was one Huang Shun who hid in the overlapping borderlands of Hubei and Guangdong and plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Huang Shun who hid in the overlapping borderlands of Hubei and Guangdong and plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 貴州人黎阿蘭與相應，散旗印，將起事。

translations.literal: A Guizhou man, Li Alan, responded to him, distributed banners and seals, and was about to rise.
translations.idiomatic: A Guizhou man, Li Alan, responded to him, distributed banners and seals, and was about to rise.

sentences.zh: 行義诇知之，督兵攻克賊巢，擒斬首從七十餘，事乃定。

translations.literal: Xingyi learned of it through intelligence, led troops to storm the rebel nest, and captured and executed more than seventy leaders and followers; the affair was then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyi learned of it through intelligence, led troops to storm the rebel nest, and captured and executed more than seventy leaders and followers; the affair was then settled.

sentences.zh: 柳州兵皆居草舍，患火。

translations.literal: The troops at Liuzhou all lived in thatched huts and suffered from fire.
translations.idiomatic: The troops at Liuzhou all lived in thatched huts and suffered from fire.

sentences.zh: 行義請發白金四千貸兵建瓦屋，分三年還帑，從之。

translations.literal: Xingyi requested four thousand taels of silver to lend the troops to build tiled houses, to be repaid to the treasury over three years; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyi requested four thousand taels of silver to lend the troops to build tiled houses, to be repaid to the treasury over three years; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 又有李彩者，糾眾聚遷江石版村謀犯縣城，行義既捕治，請城北設汛。

translations.literal: There was also one Li Cai who gathered a crowd at Shiban Village on the Qian River plotting to attack the county seat; after Xingyi had captured and punished them, he requested a garrison north of the city.
translations.idiomatic: There was also one Li Cai who gathered a crowd at Shiban Village on the Qian River plotting to attack the county seat; after Xingyi had captured and punished them, he requested a garrison north of the city.

sentences.zh: 尋以擅發倉穀貸於兵，左授登州鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Soon, for having on his own authority issued grain from the storehouses to lend to the troops, he was demoted to regional commander of Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, for having on his own authority issued grain from the storehouses to lend to the troops, he was demoted to regional commander of Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一年，遷江南提督。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to provincial military governor of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was transferred to provincial military governor of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 十四年，移浙江提督。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was transferred to provincial military governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was transferred to provincial military governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 十六年，再移福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was again transferred to provincial military governor of Fujian land forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was again transferred to provincial military governor of Fujian land forces.

sentences.zh: 十八年，卒，諡恭愨。

sentences.zh: 雍正間，師出西北二路，怡親王允祥薦毓馪主餉，計穀多寡，程道路遠近，以次受值，凡石米自十一兩五錢至二十五兩有差，累年運米百餘萬石。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng period, when armies marched on the northwestern two routes, Prince Yi Yinxiang recommended Yuhuan to manage provisions; calculating grain quantities and distances, payment was received in order, each picul of grain ranging from eleven taels five mace to twenty-five taels; over successive years more than a million piculs were transported.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongzheng period, when armies marched on the northwestern two routes, Prince Yi Yinxiang recommended Yuhuan to manage provisions; calculating grain quantities and distances, payment was received in order, each picul of grain ranging from eleven taels five mace to twenty-five taels; over successive years more than a million piculs were transported.

sentences.zh: 世宗特賜太僕寺卿銜，章服同二品。

translations.literal: The Shizong specially granted him the title of Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, with insignia equal to the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizong specially granted him the title of Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, with insignia equal to the second rank.

sentences.zh: 寇犯北路，失米十三萬餘石，毓馪斥私財補運，凡白金百四十四萬。

translations.literal: When bandits attacked the northern route, more than one hundred and thirty thousand piculs of grain were lost; Yuhuan spent private wealth to make up the transport, altogether one million four hundred and forty thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits attacked the northern route, more than one hundred and thirty thousand piculs of grain were lost; Yuhuan spent private wealth to make up the transport, altogether one million four hundred and forty thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 師既罷，米轉運近地，戶部按近值核銷，故所受遠值，責毓馪追繳，凡白金二百六十二萬，復出私財採蓡，市銅供鑄錢以償。

translations.literal: After the army was disbanded, grain was transported to nearby places and the Board of Revenue audited at nearby values; therefore the distant values he had received were charged to Yuhuan for recovery, altogether two million six hundred and twenty thousand taels; he again spent private wealth to gather ginseng and buy copper to supply coinage for repayment.
translations.idiomatic: After the army was disbanded, grain was transported to nearby places and the Board of Revenue audited at nearby values; therefore the distant values he had received were charged to Yuhuan for recovery, altogether two million six hundred and twenty thousand taels; he again spent private wealth to gather ginseng and buy copper to supply coinage for repayment.

sentences.zh: 毓皛以武舉授衛千總，以駝佐軍，擢守備。

translations.literal: Yuxiao, as a military licentiate, was appointed company commander of the guard; with camels he assisted the army and was promoted to defender.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiao, as a military licentiate, was appointed company commander of the guard; with camels he assisted the army and was promoted to defender.

sentences.zh: 累遷直隸天津鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to regional commander of Tianjin in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to regional commander of Tianjin in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 自河南河北鎮移廣東潮州，疏請令潮州營兵如河北例，兼習長槍、短棍、連接棍諸藝。

translations.literal: Transferred from the Hebei Garrison in Henan to Chaozhou in Guangdong, he memorialized requesting that Chaozhou garrison troops, following the Hebei precedent, also practice long spears, short staffs, and linked staffs.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred from the Hebei Garrison in Henan to Chaozhou in Guangdong, he memorialized requesting that Chaozhou garrison troops, following the Hebei precedent, also practice long spears, short staffs, and linked staffs.

sentences.zh: 世宗命與總督鄂彌達、提督張溥商榷。

translations.literal: The Shizong ordered consultation with Governor-General Emida and Provincial Military Governor Zhang Pu.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizong ordered consultation with Governor-General Emida and Provincial Military Governor Zhang Pu.

sentences.zh: 鄂彌達等上言：「廣東山海交錯，軍械惟鳥槍最宜，次則弓箭、藤牌、挑刀、大砲。

translations.literal: Emida and others reported: "Guangdong’s mountains and sea interlock; firearms are most suitable, next bows and arrows, rattan shields, pole blades, and cannon.
translations.idiomatic: Emida and others reported: "Guangdong’s mountains and sea interlock; firearms are most suitable, next bows and arrows, rattan shields, pole blades, and cannon.

sentences.zh: 毓皛所議與廣東不甚宜。

translations.literal: What Yuxiao proposed is not very suitable for Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: What Yuxiao proposed is not very suitable for Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 」上韙鄂彌達等議，仍諭毓皛初至，當嘉其肯言。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved Emida’s view but still instructed that since Yuxiao had just arrived, his willingness to speak should be commended.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved Emida’s view but still instructed that since Yuxiao had just arrived, his willingness to speak should be commended.

sentences.zh: 嘉應、潮陽遇颶，海岸決。

translations.literal: Jiaying and Chaoyang were struck by typhoons and the coast was breached.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaying and Chaoyang were struck by typhoons and the coast was breached.

sentences.zh: 毓皛以聞，命加意撫綏。

translations.literal: Yuxiao reported it and was ordered to give special attention to relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiao reported it and was ordered to give special attention to relief.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，署廣東提督。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong he served as acting provincial military governor of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Qianlong reign he served as acting provincial military governor of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 故事，市舶至，詣海關納稅。

translations.literal: By precedent, when merchant vessels arrived they went to the customs to pay tax.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, when merchant vessels arrived they went to the customs to pay tax.

sentences.zh: 或遇風未至所往地，中道暫泊，亦論稅如例。

translations.literal: If they met wind and had not reached their destination, even temporary anchorage en route was taxed as usual.
translations.idiomatic: If they met wind and had not reached their destination, even temporary anchorage en route was taxed as usual.

sentences.zh: 毓皛慮民避屢稅，遇風不敢泊，致傾覆，疏請商舟寄泊，非即地市易不徵稅，上命待審察。

translations.literal: Yuxiao feared the people would avoid repeated taxation and, meeting wind, dare not anchor and so capsize; he memorialized requesting that merchant ships anchoring for shelter not be taxed unless they immediately traded on the spot; the emperor ordered pending review.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiao feared the people would avoid repeated taxation and, meeting wind, dare not anchor and so capsize; he memorialized requesting that merchant ships anchoring for shelter not be taxed unless they immediately traded on the spot; the emperor ordered pending review.

sentences.zh: 毓皛以憂歸，服終，授直隸正定鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Yuxiao returned on account of mourning; when mourning ended he was appointed regional commander of Zhengding in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiao returned on account of mourning; when mourning ended he was appointed regional commander of Zhengding in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 湖廣總督阿爾賽請移任苗疆，上不允，諭以「毓皛富家子弟，謹慎無過。

translations.literal: Huguang Governor-General Aersai requested to transfer him to the Miao frontier; the emperor did not consent and instructed that "Yuxiao is the son of a wealthy family, cautious and without fault.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang Governor-General Aersai requested to transfer him to the Miao frontier; the emperor did not consent and instructed that "Yuxiao is the son of a wealthy family, cautious and without fault.

sentences.zh: 苗疆事重，不能勝也」。

translations.literal: Miao frontier affairs are weighty; he cannot bear them."
translations.idiomatic: Miao frontier affairs are weighty; he cannot bear them."

sentences.zh: 上巡五台，毓皛言兄毓馪子清注具羊千、馬十備賞賚，上卻之。

translations.literal: On the emperor’s tour of Wutai, Yuxiao said that his elder brother Yuhuan’s son Qingzhu had prepared a thousand sheep and ten horses as gifts; the emperor declined them.
translations.idiomatic: On the emperor’s tour of Wutai, Yuxiao said that his elder brother Yuhuan’s son Qingzhu had prepared a thousand sheep and ten horses as gifts; the emperor declined them.

sentences.zh: 尋以老罷。

translations.literal: Soon he retired on account of age.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he retired on account of age.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：提鎮雖專閫，然受制於督撫，所轄兵散處諸營汛，都試肄武，虛存其制耳。

translations.literal: =【Discussion】= Discussion: Although provincial military governors and regional commanders hold independent commands, they are constrained by governors-general and governors; the troops under them are scattered at various camps and posts, and the metropolitan examinations and military drills exist only in form.
translations.idiomatic: Discussion: Although provincial military governors and regional commanders hold independent commands, they are constrained by governors-general and governors; the troops under them are scattered at various camps and posts, and the metropolitan examinations and military drills exist only in form.

sentences.zh: 無黨、進義皆能勤其官者，行義捕盜，廷屢從戰，皆有勞。

translations.literal: Wudang and Jinyi were both able to attend diligently to their offices; Xingyi captured bandits; Ting repeatedly followed campaigns—all had merit.
translations.idiomatic: Wudang and Jinyi were both able to attend diligently to their offices; Xingyi captured bandits; Ting repeatedly followed campaigns—all had merit.

sentences.zh: 進升龂龂不欲曠其職。

translations.literal: Jinsheng was contentious and unwilling to neglect his duties.
translations.idiomatic: Jinsheng was contentious and unwilling to neglect his duties.

sentences.zh: 毓皛與其兄出私財助軍興，幾傾其家而不悔，求諸往史，所未有也。

translations.literal: Yuxiao and his elder brother spent private wealth to assist military campaigns, nearly ruining their household yet without regret—sought in past histories, there has never been such a case.
translations.idiomatic: Yuxiao and his elder brother spent private wealth to assist military campaigns, nearly ruining their household yet without regret—sought in past histories, there has never been such a case.
